name: Power Channeler [Psionic]
body:
You have learned how to channel your powers through your weaponry, allowing you to make melee attacks and channel offensive powers at the same time.

Benefit: You can channel a touch range power through a melee weapon. You can make a single melee attack during the same action in which you manifest a touch power with a manifesting time of one standard action; if this melee attack hits, it triggers the power as if you had succeeded on a touch attack and deals damage as normal. If you miss, the power fizzles and the charge is lost. The attack made is against standard AC and not touch AC.
